task.question: Who became the first US dollar trillionaire in June 2026?
task.evidence: June 12 – Elon Musk becomes the first US dollar trillionaire with the initial public offering of SpaceX.

answer:
Elon Musk became the first US dollar trillionaire in June 2026, specifically on June 12, 2026, due to the initial public offering of SpaceX. 

FINAL: Elon Musk

Who became the first US dollar trillionaire in June 2026?

[Trillionaire] A trillionaire is a person whose net worth is at least one trillion units of a given currency, typically the US dollar due to its status as a world currency. A trillionaire is the highest tier of ultra-high-net-worth individuals. In June 2026, Elon Musk became the only US dollar trillionaire in history upon the initial public offering of his company, SpaceX, but Musk's net worth fell below $1 trillion in early July 2026, after a SpaceX stock drop wiped hundreds of billions from his net worth. Musk regained trillionaire status in early October 2026 after Tesla, Inc. and SpaceX stocks climbed.
